project: HomeGuard — Self-Hosted Personal Data Broker Removal System

requirements.text: Support 2-5 household member profiles
Store full name, aliases, addresses (versioned), phones, emails, DOB, relatives per profile
Profile edits trigger re-scan scheduling
Admin role (full access) and Member role (own profile read-only)
PII stored locally, never transmitted except as part of explicit logged removal request
Profile pause state — suspends automation without deleting data, reversible
Identity document storage per profile for brokers requiring ID verification
Maintain versioned registry across 4 categories: people_search, data_broker, background_check, social_web
n8n workflows auto-discover new brokers weekly from EFF, GitHub opt-out lists
New brokers added to registry without manual intervention
Each broker record: domain, removal_method, opt_out_url, required_fields, response_days, captcha_flag, last_verified_at
Flag brokers whose opt-out mechanism has changed or become unreachable
Registry browsable and searchable in dashboard; manual overrides supported
Daily automated scan of all active brokers for each active profile
Scans check name, address, phone, email, DOB, relatives across broker databases
Results record: fields found, broker, profile, timestamp, screenshot
Re-listing detection — auto-initiate new removal if previously removed profile re-listed
Retry failed scans up to 3 times with exponential backoff before marking inconclusive
Verification re-scan after broker confirms removal (default 14 days after confirmation)
Randomised request delays and user-agent rotation to reduce blocking risk
Proxy/IP rotation support via PLAYWRIGHT_PROXY_URL
Auto-initiate removal workflow on exposure detection without user approval
Web form opt-out: headless browser automation via Playwright
Email opt-out: auto-compose and send from dedicated removal mailbox
CCPA/GDPR brokers: generate and dispatch legally formatted deletion request
Each request logged with unique ID, method, broker, profile, timestamp, status
Auto follow-up if no confirmation within broker response window (default 30 days, max 3 attempts)
ID-verification required brokers surfaced as dashboard action items
Full lifecycle status per request
Auto status transitions from scan results, email replies, time thresholds
Parse inbound emails: confirmed_removal | rejection | info_requested | unclassified
Unresolvable requests surfaced as dashboard action items with raw email body
Web-based dashboard on LAN, Cloudflare Tunnel compatible
Household summary: total exposures, active requests, confirmed removals, re-listings
Profile detail: exposure score, per-broker status, field exposure breakdown, request history
Notification queue: exposures, removals, failures, re-listings, action items, health alerts
Manual scan trigger, failed request resubmission, legal letter viewing
System Health view: service status, last scan time, queue depth, disk usage
First-run onboarding wizard: admin account, profiles, email config, n8n connectivity, broker seed
Append-only compliance audit log — all actions recorded with actor, timestamp, outcome
Historical exposure score per profile over time as daily time-series trend graph
Re-listing tracker: broker, re-list date, occurrence count, days between removal and re-list
Field exposure breakdown: which fields at which brokers, current removal status
Export in PDF and CSV formats
PII encrypted at rest at database column level
Dashboard requires username/password authentication (1 admin, up to 4 members)
All secrets managed via environment variables, never committed to version control
Internal services isolated on private Docker network
Cloudflare Tunnel compatible — HOST_BIND_ADDRESS env var controls binding
Configurable session timeouts, JWT tokens in memory only
Configurable screenshot retention (default 90 days), auto-purge on schedule
Configurable log rotation (default 30 days)
System Health view shows disk usage with configurable warning thresholds
Audit log exempt from auto-purge — retained indefinitely unless manually purged
Broker playbook library versioned and updatable independently of application code
Playbook update mechanism: pull from file, URL, or Git without full image rebuild
Dashboard shows running image versions and indicates when updates are available
Documented backup/restore procedure for all named Docker volumes

TR6_playwright.title: Scanning & Headless Automation — Playwright
TR6_playwright.playbooks: Versioned JSON per broker in registry.broker_playbooks
TR6_playwright.captcha_strategy: manual default — flag and surface as action item

TR7_celery_redis.title: Task Queue — Celery 5 + Redis 7
TR7_celery_redis.scheduler: Celery Beat — daily scans at 02:00 via SCAN_SCHEDULE_CRON
TR7_celery_redis.follow_up_scheduling: Celery ETA at request creation time

TR8_email.title: Email Handling — SMTP/IMAP
TR8_email.outbound: SMTP via Jinja2 templates + WeasyPrint for PDF legal letters
TR8_email.inbound: IMAP polling every 15 minutes by mailwatcher service

TR10_observability.title: Observability & Reporting
TR10_observability.logging: Structured JSON to stdout — Docker json-file driver max-size 50m max-file 5
TR10_observability.screenshot_purge: Nightly Celery Beat task per SCREENSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS
